answer: Anchor each identity to a registered coastal tide gauge. Each epoch the gauge signs a fresh tidal curve — high and low water marks — bound to the epoch nonce and checked against harmonic predictions. Its spiral float cable gives every station a unique fingerprint: no two gauges trace the same curve. One hundred puppets sharing one gauge report one identical tide and collapse to a single vote, stake burned. Forging a hundred votes means running a hundred real gauges on a hundred distinct shores, each with an ivory staff. Replaying last epoch's curve dies on the fresh nonce.
